title: Frontend: Dark mode support via Tailwind dark variant and theme toggle
description: Implement dark mode using Tailwind's class-based dark mode. Add a theme toggle button and persist preference in localStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind dark mode uses class strategy (darkMode: ['class'])
Theme toggle button (sun/moon icon) in the sidebar or header
All shadcn/ui components and custom components render correctly in dark mode

steps.details: Create src/hooks/useTheme.ts. State: theme ('light'|'dark'|'system'). On mount: read from localStorage, fallback to 'system'. Apply: if theme='dark', add 'dark' class to document.documentElement. If theme='light', remove it. If theme='system', use window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'). Persist to localStorage on change.
Create src/components/ui/ThemeToggle.tsx. Button with Sun icon (light mode) / Moon icon (dark mode). Cycles through light → dark → system on click. Or use a simple toggle between light and dark.
Place ThemeToggle in the sidebar bottom or header. Make sure it's visible and accessible.
Click theme toggle — verify dark mode applied (background becomes dark). Reload — verify preference persists. Check all major views in dark mode for visual issues.
